app.name: Ultiorganizer Scorekeeper
home.title: Ultiorganizer Scorekeeper
home.recentEmpty: Games you open show up here.
home.linkHint: Opens the games of this link without scanning
home.noServers: No server paired yet. Scan the setup QR from your Ultiorganizer server, or pair one in Settings.
pair.title: Pair a server
pair.intro: Scan the setup QR from the server's Scorekeeping app page. On the same phone, copy the setup link there and paste it below, or enter the address and an app token.
pair.linkInvalid: This is not a setup link. Copy it from the server's Scorekeeping app page.
pair.warning: Anyone holding this token can keep score with any scorekeeping link. Keep it private.
scan.title: Scan QR
scan.hint: Point the camera at the scorekeeping QR or the setup QR.
scan.permission: Camera access is needed to scan QR codes.
scan.error.not_a_url: This is not a QR code the app can use.
scan.error.wrong_kind: This QR code is not for scorekeeping or pairing.
scan.error.bad_root: The server address in this QR code is not valid.
scan.error.bad_link_token: The scorekeeping link in this QR code is not valid.
scan.error.missing_token: This setup QR code has no token.
games.title: Games
games.opensOn: Games open for scorekeeping only on their game day. These games open on {{date}}.
games.empty: No games to keep right now.
games.error.network: The server could not be reached.
games.error.bad_body: The server's answer could not be read.
timekeeper.title: Timekeeper
timekeeper.templateHint: The new limits apply from the next action. A game clock that has already started keeps its caps.
timekeeper.notifications: Signals continue in the background when notifications are allowed.
timekeeper.notification.title: {{action}}
settings.title: Settings
settings.autoPoint.hint: Start the Start of point timer automatically after each goal.
settings.scorekeeper.hint: Filled in for games that have no scorekeeper yet. Change it per game on the Sheet tab.
settings.forget.confirm_one: Forget this server? Its {{count}} game is deleted from this phone, and it has to be paired again.
settings.forget.confirm_other: Forget this server? Its {{count}} games are deleted from this phone, and it has to be paired again.
settings.forget.unsent_one: {{count}} entry has not been sent to the server. Forgetting the server deletes its games and loses it.
settings.forget.unsent_other: {{count}} entries have not been sent to the server. Forgetting the server deletes its games and loses them.
game.notSynced: Waiting to sync. The game is saved on this phone and will be sent when the connection returns.
game.noRoster: Set the rosters to record goals, or use +1 and −1 to count points only.
game.conflict.title: Someone else changed this game
game.rosterDefault: All {{count}} players selected, not saved yet
game.noPlayers: No players for this team on the server. Add them in Ultiorganizer, then reopen this game.
error.spirit_stoppages_disabled: Spirit stoppages are not used in this event.
error.score_out_of_range: The score is out of range.
error.player_referenced: A goal or the defence sheet refers to this player.
error.validation_failed: The server did not accept this entry.
error.invalid_scorekeeping_token: The scorekeeping link is no longer valid.
error.scorekeeping_app_not_allowed: This event does not allow your app token. Ask an event admin to check the event's Scorekeeping app setting.
game.resumeAuth: Try again with the saved link
error.busy: A request is still being sent. Try again in a moment.
error.no_token: The game has not been read from the server yet.
home.deleteConfirm: Delete this game from the phone?
home.deleteUnsent: {{count}} entries have not been sent to the server. Deleting the game loses them.
pair.error.rejected: The server did not accept this token.
game.capsLocal: This server does not store caps yet, so they are kept on this phone only.
error.times_hidden: Caps are not recorded while the event hides times.
error.point_cap_too_low: A new point cap must be greater than the current score.
games.offline: Offline. This is the game list saved at {{time}}; scores may have changed since. Entries are kept on this phone and sent when the connection returns.
games.error.notSaved: The server could not be reached, and this game was not saved on this phone while it was online.
games.error.forbidden: The server refused this game. The scorekeeping link may no longer cover it.
local.title: Local game
local.body: For a game the server does not know, for example after a late schedule change. It is kept on this phone only: it is not linked to the server and is never uploaded, so enter the result in Ultiorganizer afterwards. There are no player names: +1 asks for the assist's and the scorer's jersey numbers.
game.localNote: Local game: kept on this phone only and never uploaded.
game.correctGoalHint: Pick the assist and scorer again
game.noteBytes: {{bytes}} of {{max}} characters (accented letters count as two)
game.notePersonal: Game notes need a personal app token. Set up the app with the code on your Scorekeeping app page in Ultiorganizer to write one.
game.noteAbsent: This server does not store game notes.
